answer: Amateur-radio callsign attestation ties each identity to a licensed callsign earned by passing an exam and an in-person ID check. On signup, the applicant must transmit a signed whisper signal on their frequency at the nadir of the solar cycle, when propagation is weakest, and three distant receivers must log it. One callsign backs one identity. Forging 100 identities needs 100 exams, licences and transceivers at $335 each, $33,500 in total.
